description: The plot illustrates the relationship between layer number and sparsity ratio for different stages of a process. The x-axis is labeled “Layer” and has a linear scale ranging from -1 to 21, with tick labels at integer values. The y-axis is labeled “Sparsity Ratio” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 0.8, with tick labels at intervals of 0.2. A dashed blue line, labeled “sparsity ratio before gate, avg 0.003”, begins at approximately -1 with a value of 0.8 and remains relatively constant at approximately 0.01 across the x-axis range. An orange dotted line begins at approximately -1 with a value of 0.8 and declines to approximately 0.15 at x=21. A green dashed line begins at approximately -1 with a value of 0.8 and declines more steeply to approximately 0.05 at x=21.
